refresh_cadence: daily check; published team lists for a concluded event do not change
known_risks: Rate-limiting/ToS posture for sustained scheduled access not independently verified
Only the day-2 cut is published (156 of 1096 players at NAIC 2026), so this is a top-cut view, not full event coverage
No EV or IV spreads are published; official team sheets do not carry them (see docs/data-sources.md's Victory Road entry)
Pokémon are identified by Limitless' own slug, which needs a controlled mapping seed to reach pokemon_key

fields.name: limitless_team_id
fields.description: Limitless' canonical team-list id; shared across every player and event that fielded the same composition

fields.name: tournament_id
fields.description: Limitless' own tournament id (not the RK9/MunchStats event_id; these are different ID spaces)

fields.name: rk9_event_id
fields.description: RK9 event id this tournament links out to; equals tournament_event.event_id, and is the join key back to MunchStats-sourced events. Blank when the tournament page carries no RK9 link

fields.name: tournament_name
fields.description: Tournament display name, e.g. "NAIC 2026, New Orleans"

fields.name: tournament_date
fields.description: Tournament date as ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)

fields.name: regulation_set
fields.description: Regulation set slug the event was played under, e.g. "m-a" for Champions

fields.name: placement
fields.description: Final standing of this player at this tournament

fields.name: player_name
fields.description: Player display name as reported by Limitless

fields.name: player_country
fields.description: Player's two-letter country code, if reported

fields.name: limitless_player_id
fields.description: Limitless' own player id; blank when the standings row carries no player link

fields.name: slot_number
fields.description: 1-based roster slot within the team list

fields.name: pokemon_slug
fields.description: Limitless' own species/form slug, e.g. "arcanine-hisui"; resolved to pokemon_key via the limitless_slug_to_pokeapi_form seed

fields.name: pokemon_display_name
fields.description: Human-readable species/form name as printed on the team list

fields.name: item_name
fields.description: Held item; blank when the published list omits one

fields.name: ability
fields.description: Ability; blank when the published list omits one

fields.name: nature
fields.description: Nature (printed as "Stat Alignment" on official team sheets); blank when omitted

fields.name: moves
fields.description: Pipe-delimited move names for this slot

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: Provenance: originating source name

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Provenance: the team-list URL this row was read from

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Provenance: tournament/team/player/slot composite

fields.name: extracted_at_utc
fields.description: Provenance: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the extraction run

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Provenance: dataset version this snapshot was staged toward
